column1: Ketel Marte leads the slate with a strong combination of consistency and a favorable matchup, batting leadoff on the road with the platoon advantage against Miles Mikolas. Luis Arraez also offers excellent reliability atop the Giants’ order, especially given his high rate of games with a hit. Yandy Diaz and Ernie Clement both benefit from lineup position and advantageous matchups, but Marte’s steady track record and situational edge make him the top pick today.
